_comment: CANONICAL BotNexus label taxonomy. Single source of truth for Set-BotNexusLabel.ps1, SKILL.md and every agent brief. Six namespaces, each with a defined cardinality. Any label not listed here is not writable by the sanctioned script.

type.description: What kind of work this is. Maps 1:1 to conventional-commit type.

type:improvement.description: Behaviour-changing enhancement to something that already works. Conventional commit: perf

type:chore.description: Maintenance with no product behaviour change: deps, CI, build. Conventional commit: chore/ci/build

type:test.description: Test coverage work. Conventional commit: test

type:spike.description: Research/investigation - produces a plan, not code

type:epic.description: Parent issue that decomposes into sub-issues

priority:high.description: High priority - fix in current cycle

priority:medium.description: Medium priority - fix in next cycle

area:channels.description: Channel adapters: Telegram, Service Bus, SignalR, webhook

area:tooling.description: Agent tool hardening and instruction improvements

area:trailguide.description: Trail Guide agent: onboarding, guidance and troubleshooting skills

status:blocked.description: Blocked on external dependency or architectural prerequisite

status:needs-jon-decision.description: Blocked on Jon. Jon clears when answered; Farnsworth re-adds if more info needed.

status:in-progress.description: Claimed by an agent worker until publication releases the claim.

status:ready-for-agent.description: Explicitly admitted for agent delivery by a trusted actor.

source:opencode.description: Found by the OpenCode daily delta audit

source:team-servicebus.description: Filed from the team Service Bus channel; users describe their own platforms, not this one.

source:user-feedback.description: User feedback - high signal, needs attention

_migration_comment: Legacy label -> canonical label. Applied by -Migrate. A null target means DELETE the label without replacement (dead taxonomy).
_precedence_comment: When an item carries more than one label from an exactly-one/at-most-one namespace (legacy double-tagging), the FIRST match in this list wins and the rest are removed. Deterministic so the same input always yields the same result. epic outranks everything because a parent issue is an epic first; bug outranks feature because a report of broken behaviour is a defect even when it implies new work.
_dead_comment: Labels to DELETE. Every one is either zero-usage or a retired workflow. Deleting a label removes it from historical issues, which is why each is listed explicitly rather than inferred.
_pr_rules_comment: Mechanical PR labelling. type comes from the conventional-commit type in the PR title; area labels are unioned from path globs against the PR's changed files. No judgement, so the result is reproducible.
